message.content:
**Allele frequency of rs7412 (APOE ε2) in Europeans**

| Population (subset of 1000 Genomes) | Allele frequency (C allele) |
|-------------------------------------|-----------------------------|
| CEU (Utah residents with Northern/Western European ancestry) | ~0.13 |
| TSI (Toscani in Italy) | ~0.12 |
| IBS (Iberian Spanish) | ~0.11 |
| FIN (Finnish) | ~0.09 |
| Overall European average (combined 1000 Genomes + gnomAD) | **≈ 0.12–0.15** |

> **Interpretation**  
> The C allele at rs7412 corresponds to the APOE ε2 allele, which is the “protective” variant against late‑onset Alzheimer’s disease. In most European populations it occurs in roughly 10–15 % of chromosomes, giving a carrier frequency of about 20–30 % (since most carriers are heterozygous).

**Sources**

* 1000 Genomes Project Phase 3 – allele counts for rs7412 in the CEU, TSI, IBS, and FIN cohorts.  
* gnomAD v2.1.1 – aggregated allele frequencies for European (EUR) superpopulation.  

**Note**  
Allele frequencies can vary slightly between sub‑European groups (e.g., higher in Southern Europe, lower in Northern Europe). If you need a precise value for a specific cohort, consult the raw allele counts from the 1000 Genomes or gnomAD databases.
